note: Hotfix — Resonance ResizeObserver was in a tight reallocation loop. Each fire set canvas.width/height (new backing store + forced layout) which fired the observer again. v5.79.11 silent:true removed the modal that was masking the loop; the site started slowing and Resonance rendered blank. Fix: dimension-change threshold guard (>= 4px), setTransform instead of compound scale, null-guard on canvas/container. Preserves Harmonia's window-resize intent while breaking the loop.
label: v5.79.12 — Hotfix: Resonance ResizeObserver loop
